purpose: Current unified provenance index for Figure 2 and natural-xenon results, including the seven-isotope AFH response grid, AFH-7/Hybrid-9 spectra, native Xe-131 response validation, and the completed native Mathematica/Python full Eq. (6) cross-code archive.
sha256_method: For committed text files listed here, SHA-256 was recomputed from exact repository file bytes returned in base64 form. For artifacts covered by existing committed SHA256SUMS, the recorded per-file digest was cross-checked against that manifest. External/uncommitted inputs are explicitly listed as checksum-only provenance, not as locally available files.
